changes.name: DirectionalIslandExpansion
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local core=world:WaitForChild("EnergyCore")
local prompt=core:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")

-- Top-down layout based on the player's current starter island:
-- NORTH = away from spawn, EAST = right side, SOUTH = toward spawn.
-- Expansion order alternates those three directions so the island grows outward around the starter area.
local layouts={
 {name="NorthExpansion1",pos=Vector3.new(0,18.5,-40),size=Vector3.new(42,3,26),color=Color3.fromRGB(92,180,96)},
 {name="EastExpansion1",pos=Vector3.new(40,18.5,0),size=Vector3.new(26,3,42),color=Color3.fromRGB(92,180,96)},
 {name="SouthExpansion1",pos=Vector3.new(0,18.5,40),size=Vector3.new(42,3,26),color=Color3.fromRGB(92,180,96)},
 {name="NorthExpansion2",pos=Vector3.new(0,18.5,-68),size=Vector3.new(48,3,28),color=Color3.fromRGB(95,145,180)},
 {name="EastExpansion2",pos=Vector3.new(68,18.5,0),size=Vector3.new(28,3,48),color=Color3.fromRGB(120,105,165)},
 {name="SouthExpansion2",pos=Vector3.new(0,18.5,68),size=Vector3.new(48,3,28),color=Color3.fromRGB(175,135,85)},
 {name="NorthExpansion3",pos=Vector3.new(0,18.5,-98),size=Vector3.new(56,3,30),color=Color3.fromRGB(105,205,150)},
 {name="EastExpansion3",pos=Vector3.new(98,18.5,0),size=Vector3.new(30,3,56),color=Color3.fromRGB(105,165,205)},
 {name="SouthExpansion3",pos=Vector3.new(0,18.5,98),size=Vector3.new(56,3,30),color=Color3.fromRGB(160,115,190)}
}

-- Hide old progression land so it does not grow west or diagonally.
local oldNames={"Expansion1","Expansion2","Bridge","TreasureIsland","SkyGarden","LavaIsland","CloudBridge","AncientIsland","MoonIsland","VoidBridge","VoidIsland","FinalRealm"}
for _,name in ipairs(oldNames) do
 local p=world:FindFirstChild(name)
 if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Transparency=1;p.CanCollide=false end
end

local folder=world:FindFirstChild("DirectionalExpansions") or Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="DirectionalExpansions";folder.Parent=world
local pieces={}
for i,d in ipairs(layouts) do
 local p=folder:FindFirstChild(d.name) or Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=d.name;p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.Material=Enum.Material.Grass;p.Color=d.color
 p.Size=d.size;p.Position=d.pos-Vector3.new(0,14,0);p.Transparency=1;p.Parent=folder
 pieces[i]={part=p,target=d.pos}
end

local function reveal(index)
 local info=pieces[index]
 if not info or info.part.Transparency<1 then return end
 local p=info.part
 p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true
 TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.8,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=info.target}):Play()
end

local busy={}
local function update(player)
 local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
 if not stage or not prompt then return end
 if stage.Value<9 then prompt.ActionText="Expand Island - 1 Energy"
 else prompt.ActionText="Island Expanded!"
 end
end

-- This script owns directional expansion. It converts any stage progress into the matching directional land.
local function hook(player)
 local stage=player:WaitForChild("IslandStage")
 for i=1,math.min(stage.Value,#pieces) do reveal(i) end
 stage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
  for i=1,math.min(stage.Value,#pieces) do reveal(i) end
  update(player)
 end)
 update(player)
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(hook,p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)

print("Directional expansion layout loaded: North, East, South")
